decisions.reason: As a burner component tied to the firm’s established radiant-heating business, it is more likely to be retained as a supporting portfolio element than withdrawn so soon after launch.
This electric infrared panel heater line is a highlighted strategic product with several models and fits the firm’s move toward broader, lower-carbon building-climate solutions.
Although it broadens the electric heating offer, the halogen infrared heater is less clearly central than the flagship lines and faces some overlap risk within the portfolio.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater line is close to the core business, offered in several models, and matches customer demand for efficient heating in large non-residential spaces.
The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is a flagship direction product with an early real-world reference installation and strong alignment with the firm’s stated low-carbon strategy.
